questions.prompt: Where does a project list the registries the shadcn MCP server can search?

options.explanation: Right. shadcn says registries are configured in the project's components.json file.
shadcn's page names components.json for registries, not package.json.
.env.local holds a private registry's token. The registries themselves go in components.json.

questions.prompt: Storybook's components manifest: what is its default setting?

options.explanation: Storybook says it is off by default, and not every framework makes one.

options.text: Off until you turn it on
options.explanation: Right. Storybook says the components manifest is off by default. Set componentsManifest: true.

options.text: On only in a built Storybook
options.explanation: The setting is the same in dev and in a build. It is off by default.

questions.prompt: Which file lets every Claude Code user on a team get the same MCP servers?

options.explanation: That file holds local and user scope servers. Those stay private to you.
That is Codex's project file, not Claude Code's.
Right. Anthropic says to check .mcp.json into version control so the whole team gets the same MCP tools.
